answer: Each sponsor runs one meadow plot, 3 vouches per epoch at $150 each, and 5 newcomers per meadow. A newcomer needs a mirror pair of sponsors from two meadows vouching one face. Five rotating auditors check each pair within 48 hours. A proven fake burns both stakes, freezes the plot 10 epochs, and the ripple halves the whole meadow's weight. Bonds rise $500 per new meadow, so 100 clones across 20 meadows need 67 sponsors at $400 plus $30,000 stakes and $105,000 bonds, $161,800 lost against $0 net for 100 honest agents. Like a village garden, one poisoned bed withers the whole row.
